description: RLCDAlignBench: 44 alignment-failure detection benchmarks and code for 'Just Ask Jev' (RLCD zero-shot detector of AI alignment failures)
summary: RLCDAlignBench hands you 7,193 labelled detection instances across ten failure types on 2B-to-7B open models, which is the exact scale I run in PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket when I need to tell whether a routed agent session is hallucinating or concealing uncertainty rather than just doing its job. The "Just Ask Jev" readout — one call that returns calibrated probabilities per typed question instead of an argmax verdict — is the kind of composable, low-toil check I'd slot in front of my agent routing without spinning up a separate classifier. What actually sold me is the ablation showing that reading those answers as probabilities instead of thresholding them beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks; that's the sort of small, concrete engineering result that changes how you build.
